name: Consolidation Ownership
description: Maintain consolidation method, consolidation % and ownership % per consolidation group and unit. NCI % is calculated for display only. All data crosses the script boundary as delimited text, so no JSON functions are needed in story scripting.

widgetTitle.description: Title shown in the widget header

scopeText.description: Context line under the title, set from the story script

includeEmptyRows.description: Show unbooked group/unit combinations as empty maintainable rows

percentScale.description: Model scale for PCON/POWN. 100 = model stores 1 for 100% (fractions). 1 = model already stores 0-100.

defaultMethod.description: Method id applied to newly added units

methodList.description: Consolidation methods as id~text~pgroup records, optionally followed by ~consolidation %~ownership % to FIX the method's percentages, and by two more to say what it EXPECTS (a warning, not a lock): 101~Holding~1~~~100 expects a consolidation % of 100. pgroup 0 marks a not-consolidated method: its percentages are locked to zero.

fieldSeparator.description: Separator between fields in the strings passed from the story script

recordSeparator.description: Separator between records in the strings passed from the story script

showSaveDialog.description: Show the progress dialog for loading, refreshing and saving

apiTenantUrl.description: SAC tenant URL, no trailing slash. Leave empty to use the current origin.

apiModelId.description: Model id for the master data API. Leave empty and call setModelId() from the story script, so the id is derived from the table's data source rather than typed.

autoLoadMasterData.description: Load master data from the API when the widget initialises

memberIdColumn.description: Master data column holding the member id

memberDescColumn.description: Master data column holding the description

memberParentColumn.description: Master data column holding the hierarchy parent

useHierarchy.description: Read units from {dimension}MasterWithHierarchy so the parent column is available. Off uses the flat {dimension}Master.

showFilterBar.description: Show the version / period / group filter bar in the widget

excludeUnits.description: Consolidation unit ids to hide from the value help. Comma separated, trailing * is a prefix wildcard.

excludeGroups.description: Consolidation group ids to hide. Comma separated, trailing * is a prefix wildcard.

periodIdPattern.description: Regular expression a Date member id must match to appear in the period picker. Default keeps 6-digit base periods only. Empty shows every member.

checkLoadedScope.description: Refuse ownership data whose version or period is not the one that was asked for. Switch off only if the tenant spells the ids of the result set in a form the comparison cannot read.

diagnostics.description: Print record detail in the browser console run log. Off in production: the detail contains ownership values.

setUnits.description: Consolidation unit master data. One record per member: id~description~parentId

setGroups.description: Consolidation group master data. One record per member: id~description

setFactCells.description: Raw result set cells. One record per cell: group~unit~measureId~value. The widget pivots them into rows. Pass the version and period of the rows the table returned, or two empty strings when it returned none.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version id of the first result row, or an empty string

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Date id of the first result row, or an empty string

clearData.description: Empties the table before a new load

hasChanges.description: True when there are unsaved edits or queued deletions

getChangeCount.description: Number of records to write. Frozen from the moment Save is pressed until the save ends.

getChangeMethod.description: Method id of change i, ready for setUserInput

getChangePcon.description: Consolidation % of change i as text, ready for setUserInput

getChangePown.description: Ownership % of change i as text, ready for setUserInput

getChangePgroup.description: PGROUP of change i, derived from the method (1 = part of group, 0 = not consolidated)

getDeleteCount.description: Number of entries queued for deletion

getLastChangeGroup.description: Group of the last edited cell

getLastChangeUnit.description: Unit of the last edited cell

getLastChangeValue.description: New value of the last edited cell as text

markSaved.description: Clears the dirty state after the story script has written to the model, and makes what was saved the state Revert returns to. The next load is compared with what was saved.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description: Number of records that will be written

saveStep.description: Announce a new phase in the save dialog

saveDetail.description: Add one result line to the save log

parameters.name: ok
parameters.description: False marks the line as rejected

endSave.description: Finish the save. A failure stays on screen until it is dismissed, with or without the progress dialog.

parameters.name: success
parameters.description: False if any value was rejected

setBusy.description: Show or hide the busy indicator

showMessage.description: Show a message inside the widget. Kind error stays until dismissed; info and success fade.

loadMasterDataFromApi.description: Fetch consolidation unit and group master data from the SAC Data Export API, including the hierarchy parent

revertChanges.description: Discard all unsaved edits and deletions, restoring the last loaded state

setVersionOptions.description: Fill the version dropdown. Records id~description.

setPeriodOptions.description: Fill the period dropdown. Records id~description.

getFilterGroupCount.description: Number of selected consolidation groups. Zero means all.

getFilterUnitCount.description: Number of selected consolidation units. Zero means all.

getFilterUnitAt.description: Selected consolidation unit i, as the qualified model key

setModelId.description: The model id for the master data API, normally TBL.getDataSource().getInfo().modelId. Starts the master data load if it has not run.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Model id, plain or in the t.N.id:id form

applyFilterSelection.description: Call before setting the table filters from the filter bar: records the filter bar's selection as the scope that was asked for.

getLoadedVersion.description: Version the rows on screen were read for. The only version a save may write to.

getLoadedPeriod.description: Period the rows on screen were read for. The only period a save may write to.

countConflicts.description: Pass the cells read again just before a save. Returns how many of the records about to be written no longer hold what was loaded.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Delimited cell list, as for setFactCells

getConflictText.description: The records countConflicts found, as text for a message

onOwnershipChanged.description: A method or percentage was edited. Use the getLastChange methods for details.

onRowAdded.description: A consolidation unit was added from the hierarchy popup.

onRowRemoved.description: One or more entries were queued for deletion.

onSaveRequested.description: The user pressed Save. Loop over getChangeCount(), write to the model, then call markSaved().

onRefreshRequested.description: The user pressed Reload. Re-read the model and call setFactCells().

onMasterDataLoaded.description: Fired when master data has been loaded from the API

onFilterChanged.description: Apply was pressed in the filter bar. Set the table dimension filters and reload.
